0.original: A peculiar crystal lies on the Capitol's polished floor.

28.original: Search for yet still more crystals.

48.original: A peculiar crystal lies on the floor. Upon its surface, an array of lights twinkle like a tiny constellation of stars...

49.original: (-Crimson Crystal-)<hex:024804F2022303>...day forth...bring honor to the seat of...<hex:0248020103>

50.original: The distorted voice of an ancient rings out in your mind. A moment preserved in the crystal, it would seem.

51.original: You notice something else glinting up ahead.

52.original: You find three more crystals lying on the floor. Though they differ in color and decoration, each is identical in shape.

53.original: You focus on the crystals, and find that the words they hold ring clearer than before.

55.original: (-Yellow Crystal-)<hex:024804F2022303>Embraced by the earth and caressed by the wind, vibrant life flourishes. All is right in creation.<hex:0248020103>

56.original: (-Green Crystal-)<hex:024804F2022303>There can be no greater joy than to use our wisdom for the good of our people. No greater pride.<hex:0248020103>

57.original: (-Grey Crystal-)<hex:024804F2022303>May all know happiness, now and forevermore.<hex:0248020103>

58.original: There do not appear to be any more crystals in the hall. Perhaps it would be wise to continue the search outside.

59.original: Your instincts serve you true, and you discover another two crystals.

60.original: As you reach out with your consciousness, new voices begin to echo in your mind...

61.original: (-Pale Green Crystal-)<hex:024804F2022303>The heavens are ablaze and the land rent asunder. What will become of the world? Is life itself to be denied?<hex:0248020103>

62.original: (-Purple Crystal-)<hex:024804F2022303>Come what may, we must not surrender to despair. If we but hold fast to hope, we may yet find a path to salvation.<hex:0248020103>

63.original: The voices tell an incomplete tale. Might more remain to be found?

64.original: You soon discover two more crystals. Rather <hex:021A020203>too<hex:021A020103> soon, in fact, as if someone wanted you to find them...

65.original: (-Blue Crystal-)<hex:024804F2022303>Everything burns. Crumbles. Decays. I hear the lamentations of my brethren. And soon there will be only silence.<hex:0248020103>

66.original: (-Turquoise Crystal-)<hex:024804F2022303>We will deliver our star from its doom, this we swear. So please, dry your tears.<hex:0248020103>

67.original: Whatever awaits at the end of your search, it is plain you have yet to find it.

68.original: Sure enough, your persistence is swiftly rewarded, this time with three crystals.

69.original: (-Sky Blue Crystal-)<hex:024804F2022303>The time is come. We shall rewrite the laws of creation. And we shall save our star.<hex:0248020103>

70.original: (-Colorless Crystal-)<hex:024804F2022303>From this life, our savior born... May I be worthy of the honor.<hex:0248020103>

71.original: (-Pink Crystal-)<hex:024804F2022303>I feel my soul turning. Slowly but irrevocably. And the power I wield begins to seem terrible... But this is right. It is right.

72.original: The tale the crystals weave seems to near its end, but it isn't over yet...

73.original: With almost melancholy inevitability, the twelfth crystal soon reveals itself to your questing eye.

74.original: (-Scarlet Crystal-)<hex:024804F2022303>Though salvation is ours, it came at great sacrifice. All that remains is to pray...<hex:0248020103>

75.original: (-Scarlet Crystal-)<hex:024804F2022303>To pray that we will one day meet again, beneath a blue sky.<hex:0248020103>

76.original: Judging by its testimony, it would seem the voice was recorded in the wake of the Final Days.

77.original: As you scan the area, another glint catches your eye.

78.original: Ahhh... Fresh air at long last. I would celebrate my return to dry land with a pot of tea─had we the luxury of time.

79.original: But we must be prepared for Elidibus. Given what we know, it is plain he will not be deterred from his course.

80.original: And nor would I, were I him. Not if it meant forsaking everything I loved.

81.original: That said, I have not forgotten how Emet-Selch sought to find common ground with us, for all our misgivings.

82.original: Ultimately, our differences were not to be bridged, of course, but one must always try. Emet-Selch understood this, and if his gesture resonated with you, perhaps you might consider reaching out to his brethren.

83.original: Though it may all be for naught, you of all people know that there is no such thing as a foregone conclusion.
